create_ConvTBC_module: create a ConvTBC 1D convolution module with specified in_channels, out_channels, and kernel_size
build_ConvTBC_with_padding: build a ConvTBC convolution layer with custom padding for time-major batch-channel input tensors
run_ConvTBC_forward: run the ConvTBC forward pass on a contiguous time-batch-channel tensor to get convolved output
test_ConvTBC_initialization: test the ConvTBC module initialization verifying weight shape is kernel_size x in_channels x out_channels
review_ConvTBC_repr: review the ConvTBC __repr__ method to confirm it displays in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, and padding
